channel.title: Concrete Projects & Calculators | YardCompute
channel.description: Slabs, patios, driveways, footings and post holes: how much concrete you need.

item.title: How Much Concrete for a Driveway? Cubic Yards Chart by Size
item.description: How many cubic yards of concrete does a driveway need? See amounts for common driveway sizes at 4 and 5 inches thick with 10% extra, then use the free concrete driveway calculator.

item.title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a Slab? 80 lb Bag Chart
item.description: How many 80 lb bags of concrete for a 4 inch slab? See bag counts for common slab sizes from 4x4 to 12x12, including 10% extra, then use the free concrete bag calculator for your own size and bag yield.

item.title: How Much Concrete per Post Hole? 80 lb Bag Chart by Hole Size
item.description: How many 80 lb bags of concrete does a post hole take? This chart shows bags for one hole and for 10 holes at common diameters and depths, with 10% extra. The free post hole calculator handles any size.
